cakechat.config.title: CakeChat
cakechat.config.history.maxMessages.desc: How many lines each chat window keeps. 0 = no limit.
cakechat.config.history.keepOnDisconnect: Keep chat when you leave a world or switch servers.
cakechat.config.compact.enabled.desc: A message that repeats an earlier one replaces it and shows a counter.
cakechat.config.compact.format.desc: Added after the message. {count} is how many times it arrived.
cakechat.config.compact.mode.desc: Newest lines: compare with the last few lines. Recent time: compare with lines from the last few seconds.
cakechat.config.compact.searchLines.desc: With 'Newest lines': how many of the newest lines are checked.
cakechat.config.compact.seconds.desc: With 'Recent time': a repeat counts only if the earlier copy arrived within this many seconds.
cakechat.config.compact.compareStyle.des: Only merge messages whose colours and formatting also match.
cakechat.config.timestamps.pattern.desc: Java date pattern, e.g. HH:mm or HH:mm:ss. An invalid pattern is not saved.
cakechat.config.timestamps.placement.des: On hover, before the message or after it.
cakechat.config.scroll.linesPerNotch.des: How many lines one mouse-wheel step scrolls. Hold Shift for one line. Minecraft: 7.
cakechat.config.scroll.invert.desc: Scroll the chat the other way round.
cakechat.config.scroll.scrollbar.desc: Show a scrollbar while the chat is open and longer than the box. It turns red when new messages arrive while you are scrolled up.
cakechat.config.window.desc: A chat window and its tabs. Move a window by dragging its tab bar, resize it with the corner at its top right (while the chat is open).
cakechat.config.tab.name: Name
cakechat.config.tab.pattern.desc: A Java regular expression. The tab shows every message where it is found. Empty = every message. Example: ^<g> for Global chat. An invalid pattern is not saved.
cakechat.config.tab.priority.desc: Tabs with a higher priority are checked first. Only matters with 'Skip other tabs'.
cakechat.config.tab.skipOthers.desc: A message this tab shows is not shown in lower-priority tabs of the same window (except tabs with 'Always add').
cakechat.config.tab.alwaysAdd.desc: Show matching messages even when a higher-priority tab skips other tabs.
cakechat.config.tab.prefix.desc: Put in front of the chat messages you send while this tab is selected, e.g. /g to send to Global. Commands you type are sent unchanged.
cakechat.config.tab.remove.desc: Asks first, then removes the tab.
cakechat.config.tab.add.desc: Saves your changes, then adds a tab that shows every message. Set its pattern to choose which.
cakechat.config.window.resetSize.desc: Saves your changes, then resets this window's size. The main window goes back to Minecraft's Chat Settings.
cakechat.config.window.add.desc: Saves your changes, then adds a chat window to the right of the main one.
cakechat.config.window.remove.desc: Asks first, then removes this window and its tabs. The messages stay in the other windows.
cakechat.config.tab.channel.desc: The server's chat channel for this tab. Selecting the tab sends /join <channel>; going back to a tab without a channel joins the channel you picked yourself again (your last own /join). CakeChat never sends /leave, and hides the server's replies to its own switches.
cakechat.config.tab.server.desc: A Java regular expression found in the server's address. The tab only shows (and only joins its channel) on matching servers. Empty = every server.
cakechat.config.tab.remove.confirm.messa: Its settings are deleted. The messages stay in the other tabs. Your unsaved changes are saved first.
cakechat.config.window.remove.confirm.me: The window, its position and all its tabs are deleted. The messages stay in the other windows. Your unsaved changes are saved first.
cakechat.find.case.desc: Match case. Off: upper and lower case are the same.
cakechat.hide.on: Chat hidden. Press %s to show it again.
